constraints.name: snapshot_version_kind
constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((((document ->> 'snapshotId'::text) = id) AND ((((document ->> 'revision'::text) = 'publish-foundation/1'::text) AND (NOT (document ? 'publicationKind'::text))) OR (((document ->> 'revision'::text) = 'publish-foundation/2'::text) AND ((document ->> 'publicationKind'::text) = 'canonical-native'::text) AND ((document ->> 'compilerVersion'::text) = 'native-publication-1'::text) AND ((document #>> '{manifest,snapshot,compilerVersion}'::text[]) = 'native-publication-1'::text)))), false))
